description: Single storey front , side and rear extension; external alterations (demolition of garage and rear extension)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-top: 5pt; margin-right: 0cm; margin-bottom: 0.0001pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</span><!--[endif]-->The
proposed ground floor rear extension, by virtue of its significant mass, depth
and height would result in&nbsp;<span pt="" sans="">an unreasonable degree of visual&nbsp;impacts and&nbsp;</span>create an undue sense of enclosure to the rear of the
No. 9 Cuckoo Hill Drive. The associated window to the flank elevation of the
proposed ground floor rear extension would also result in increased overlooking
and a loss of privacy to No. 9 Cuckoo Hill Drive. The proposal is therefore
contrary to the National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3.D(7) of the London Plan (2021), policy
DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the
adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).<span style="font-family:&quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p>The proposal, by reason of the site being
located within an area of land liable to flooding and the lack of a
comprehensive Flood Risk Assessment, due to a lack of compensatory flood storage details, has failed to demonstrate that the proposed
development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or
increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to the
National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies SI12 and SI13 of The London
Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.U of Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and Policies DM 9
and DM 10 of the Harrow Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).</p>
